In `_solve_system`, the linear-polynomial branch builds a coefficient matrix by iterating `poly.terms()` and calling `monom.index(1)`. Constant terms have no `1` in the monomial tuple, so that call is wrapped in `except ValueError`, making `ValueError` one caught exception kind. Later, in the non-linear fallback over `failed` equations, `_vsolve(eq2, s, **flags)` is wrapped in `except NotImplementedError`, and the same function can also raise `NotImplementedError('could not solve ...')` when no symbol is solvable. Across the two systems in the test, the caught exception kinds seen are therefore `ValueError` first, then `NotImplementedError`.
